title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Benefits: Standing Extra on Free Night Awards Replacement Validity
content:
**Rule.** The tier extra is the upper tier extra for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member whose elite night credits this year are at least the upper tier night threshold, the lower tier extra for a Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member whose elite night credits this year are at least the lower tier night threshold, and nothing for every other member.

The rule concerns a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed. The tier extra is added to the replacement validity months before the expiry date is worked out.

| Tier held | This year's elite night credits | Tier extra |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | At least 50 (upper tier night threshold) | 3 months (upper tier extra) |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or Platinum Elite | At least 25 (lower tier night threshold) | 1 month (lower tier extra) |
| Any other combination | — | No tier extra |

Both parts of each condition must hold: the tier and the night count. The tier is the one currently held on the Ashbury Rewards membership record, and this year's elite night credits are the credits accrued in the current calendar year shown on that record.

## Combinations (hypothetical members)

| Tier | Credits this year | Tier extra |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite | 50 | 3 months |
| Ambassador Elite | 80 | 3 months |
| Titanium Elite | 49 | None |
| Titanium Elite | 30 | None: the lower extra is for Gold Elite and Platinum Elite members |
| Platinum Elite | 25 | 1 month |
| Gold Elite | 60 | 1 month |
| Gold Elite | 24 | None |
| Silver Elite | 90 | None |
| Member | 10 | None |
